reasons.text: ECE372A studies microcontrollers and hardware interfaces through C programming, interrupts, timers, serial communication, and analog conversion.
Microcontroller programming and hardware interfaces connect an embedded-systems goal with practical device projects, so you should prepare programming and processor foundations first for later study.
ECE101 introduces C programming, control flow, software design, memory management, and elementary data structures.
Programming foundations support both directions, and you can use this course in your build phase to gain confidence with C, control flow, and memory.

Understanding processor instructions, memory, and caches provides a bridge from programming to embedded hardware during your build phase.
